Figure1: One flow solve prices all budgets; SafeOT-Dual combines filtered prices with observed-cost feedback. Lagrangian prices react after violations. Bottom: task-median cost/B; shading denotes excess. V ratios use original five-seed SafePO task medians and ratios of Bullet suite means, not shaded areas. Counts compare against TRPO-Lag. These gains do not establish a budget-coupling effect. Exact settings use c = 0; limits require assumptions.
Figure2: SafeOT-Dual adds flow-derived budget prices to a standard policy update. Gray modules are standard RL; colored modules build and solve the budgeted graph, then combine its clipped, filtered dual prices with observed-cost feedback. Width encodes visits: projection shifts flow away from the costly route while excluding hard edges. Only prices enter PPO/TRPO; the target flow is not executed. The feedback equation illustrates projected ascent; implementations may use an adaptive optimizer.
